changelog:
alibabacloud-pts-reporter 0.0.1 — initial release

- Provides a read-only analyzer for Alibaba Cloud PTS stress-testing reports, identifying and ranking performance issues based strictly on report evidence.
- Delivers actionable findings with evidence, severity, and suggestions; never creates/starts/stops PTS scenarios or diagnoses instance-level (CPU/memory/disk/network) bottlenecks.
- Requires explicit user confirmation of all input parameters; enforces strict validation and scope boundaries.
- Guides users through environment and permission checks, with clear process for handling missing credentials or insufficient permissions.
- Integrates pre-checks for CLI version, plugin installation, and AI-mode lifecycle management, ensuring a secure and predictable workflow.
- Intended to be called by the alibabacloud-pts-pilot router and only operates on historical report data (HistoryReportId + RegionId mandatory).
summary: Alibaba Cloud PTS report analyzer worker skill — analyzes past PTS stress-testing reports (HistoryReportId), identifies report-observable performance issues...
